name: openfang-rail
role: neutral x402 payment rail for M2M commerce
description: Bring-your-own-endpoint x402 rail. Sellers monetize their own tools with their own payout wallet; the rail verifies the EIP-3009 voucher and takes a transparent sub-percent toll. Zero custody: funds move payer to seller directly, on Base. Settlement is verified at the edge; the rail never holds funds.

operator.note: Set to the real operating entity before publishing. Do not ship a placeholder.

settlement.note: The 402 challenge body is always authoritative for recipient, amount, chain, and nonce. Do not hardcode.

honesty: No latency, throughput, or margin figure is published here because none is measured on this deployment. Numbers are added only after measurement.
